title: Classify sequences by their model likelihoods
description: You score each test sequence under the class models and evaluate the selected labels.

steps.description: You compute sequence_loglik under each class model. argmax selects the index with the largest score, and predict returns both the label and score array.
You collect one predicted label and score array per test sequence. vstack arranges those score arrays into rows.

steps.question: Which arrays determine the accuracy and confusion matrix?
steps.answer: Both compare y_test with y_pred. all_scores retains likelihood scores but is separate from these label comparisons.

steps.description: You print the metrics and request a confusion-matrix display with true labels on rows and predicted labels on columns. The recording reports Test Accuracy: 0.7662.
